name: Data Fabric
name_zh: Data Fabric 数据连接与查询
description_zh: 连接自己的 Data Fabric 服务，查看授权数据源和表结构并执行只读查询；较新服务可支持类型发现和已有数据源管理。
description_en: Connect your Data Fabric service to inspect authorized sources and schemas and run read-only queries. Newer servers can offer source-type discovery and existing-source management.
examples_zh: 列出我有权限访问的数据源。
查看订单表字段，统计本月订单数量。
如果当前服务支持类型发现，列出支持的数据库和文件格式。
examples_en: List the data sources I can access.
Inspect the orders table and count this month’s orders.
If this server supports type discovery, list its databases and file formats.
description: Connect your Data Fabric service to inspect authorized sources and schemas and run read-only queries. Newer servers can offer source-type discovery and existing-source management.
